title: God Makes All Things New
summary: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Revelation 21:1-5 and look for how this passage teaches: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.

tell_it: John saw a new heaven and new earth. God promised to make all things new and remove death, mourning, crying, and pain.
understand_it: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: God Makes All Things New reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Hope matters.
age_8_11_explanation: God Makes All Things New shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.
teen_explanation: God Makes All Things New gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.
God keeps His promises and gives His people future hope.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when hope is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What does God promise to make new?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: All things. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Revelation 21:5 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in God Makes All Things New?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Hope Picture
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from God Makes All Things New. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
